title: How do I choose which feedback questions my athletes see?
seoTitle: Choosing Session Feedback Questions | augo support
description: Coaches pick which of the 11 session-feedback questions their athletes are asked. Three are always asked and cannot be turned off.
summary: You choose which of the 11 available session-feedback questions your athletes are asked. Three are required and cannot be switched off; the other eight are yours to enable depending on what you are actually coaching for.

body.html: There are 11 session-feedback questions in total. You choose which ones your athletes see, and the right set changes depending on what you are coaching for.

The three you can’t turn off

  1. How did you feel during training?
  2. Any aches or pains?
  3. Anything else to add?

These are fixed because they are the ones that catch problems early. “Something concerning” on the aches question is the most useful single signal augo collects — it is the difference between hearing about an injury now and hearing about it in three weeks.

The eight you choose

The optional questions cover energy before the session, RPE, four fuelling and gut questions, recovery between intervals, and performance against expectations.

Pick for the athlete in front of you. An athlete deep in a fuelling block needs the carbohydrate questions; a time-crunched age-grouper mostly needs to tell you they were wrecked. Asking everything of everyone is the fastest way to get feedback completion rates to fall.

Changing them later

You can change the selection whenever you want. Historical answers stay attached to the sessions they belong to, so turning a question off doesn’t erase the trend you already built.

faqs.question: How many session feedback questions can I enable?
faqs.answer: All 11 if you want. Three are always on, and the remaining eight are optional — but asking everything of every athlete tends to reduce how often they answer at all.

faqs.question: Can I turn off the aches and pains question?
faqs.answer: No. It is one of three required questions, because it is the earliest warning augo gets that something is going wrong.

faqs.question: Do different athletes get different questions?
faqs.answer: The selection is yours to manage as a coach. Pick for what you are actually coaching each athlete for rather than enabling everything.
